meta.name: add-discord
meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Discord 机器人频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为应用添加 Discord 机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect Discord bot channels to your application

howto.what: Claude 会为你的应用添加 Discord 频道：自动复制并注册相关模块，安装固定版本依赖并跑通构建与测试；随后引导你在 Discord 开发者后台创建 bot、粘贴令牌、重启服务、邀请 bot 到服务器，并获取私信频道地址用于对话。
howto.when: 当用户要求为项目添加 Discord bot 频道集成（如提出“添加 Discord”或“接入 Discord bot”）时，该技能被触发。

say.text: 帮我添加 Discord 频道到项目里。
say.note: Claude 将开始执行整合步骤。

say.text: 接入 Discord bot，用 Chat SDK 桥接。
say.note: 流程包含复制模块、注册、构建测试和凭据配置。

say.text: 给项目加好 Discord 后重启服务。
say.note: Claude 会重启服务以加载新频道。

howto.what_en: Claude adds a Discord bot channel to your project: it copies/registers the adapter, installs the pinned package, runs build & tests, then walks you through bot creation, token setup, restart, inviting the bot, and resolving a DM channel.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add Discord bot channel integration, for example by requesting to add Discord or connect a Discord bot.

say_en.text: Add a Discord channel to my project.
say_en.note: Claude will start the integration steps.

say_en.text: Connect Discord bot via Chat SDK bridge.
say_en.note: Includes copying modules, registration, build/test, and credential setup.

say_en.text: After adding Discord, restart the service for me.
say_en.note: Claude will restart so the new channel loads.
